message: The other night, we had a surprise power outage, and I saw just how gloriously over-prepared I really am. I grabbed my trusty lantern, plugged my phone into a power bank, and settled in with some snacks — all while my neighbors were scrambling around looking for flashlights. It was kind of nice, actually, to be cozy instead of chaotic. I guess sometimes being that ‘prepared’ person isn’t just about safety; it can also lead to a surprisingly calm evening. Have you ever found yourself ready when others were not?
